label: PF Backlog 412
title: PFSSOT-P8A.1 finalize: auto write-back of delivery provenance + evidence on completion (PR#, merge SHA, commits, artifacts) — worker and regular paths
body: On completion of a backlog item (worker ENG-4 path OR regular feature-branch/precheck/merge path), one canonical finalize step must update the item: links.delivery={branch,merge_sha,commits[],pr,pr_url}, links.evidence={run_id,validation_run,artifacts[]}, capability refs; status->completed (gated by issue-RCCA + close_loop); revision++ + history. Reuse backlog.set_delivery + github.record_pr + github.build_evidence + merge_gate (no new store; one writer). Today set_delivery is only called MANUALLY (gap). Wire a completion/merge hook.
